summary: Corrected 17 endpoint paths that did not exist on AppTweak's API, and routed /apptweak/* reference endpoints to the sibling /api/public/apptweak base.
reason: The paths in the generated spec returned Rails route-not-found 404s on every plan (e.g. /utils/countries.json), not plan-tier limits. Paths now match developers.apptweak.com's published OpenAPI: keywords-rankings, keywords/bids, metadata/changes, featured_content/filter, reviews/top-displayed, charts/top-results, keywords/search-results, keywords/suggestions/{app,category}, keywords/apps/bids, categories/metrics, categories/benchmarks, and /apptweak/{countries,languages,dnas,usage/credits}.
validated_outcome: Live dogfood (level full, PP 4.27.0): 142 pass / 0 fail, verdict PASS.
